starter_files.contents:
# Library Management System

Run with `dotnet run`. Start with the lending rules and tests before choosing the console, desktop, or web interface.

## Done when

- [ ] Represent books, members, and loan records
- [ ] Enforce borrowing/returning invariants
- [ ] Search and report catalogue and overdue loans
- [ ] Persist data and test business rules
